description: THE BLINK -- a temporal hole bridged by grounding, the TEMPORAL TWIN of the blind spot (vision_ground) and the COMPOSITION of the grounded-field fill with TimeInfer's transition generator. Every few seconds the eyelid closes and there is NO visual input for ~100-400 ms, yet no shutter is experienced. A blink is a hole in the TEMPORAL orbit (f0,f1,[BLINK],f4,f5); it is bridged by CONTINUING the transition generator G that carries frame(t)->frame(t+1): the belief during blink tick t is CONFABULATED as a best-guess. Perception FILLS the hole by default (predictive coding: the prediction stands where there is no data -- that IS change blindness; an ungrounded fill IS hallucination, not silence). Grounding only CONSTRAINS the guess: consistent motion pins it to G^t(f0) at high confidence (invisible); an ungrounded prefix still fills, with the freeze default at confidence 0 (UNCONSTRAINED). When data RESUMES the guess is CONFIRMED (invisible) or REVISED where reality diverges (the perceptible 'jump'). The Rust BlinkBridge Term supplies the generator+continuation (reusing TimeInfer's infer/verify and apply_generator_k); the single fill rule always fires, grounding decides only constraint+confidence. Confidence is RELATIVE (confirm_run/(confirm_run+gap), the confirmed-transition support), never a fixed-K constant. In-frame/integer only (continuous motion is cross-frame, deferred -- the frame/continuum invariant). Flag-gated on agent.blink_bridge_enabled==1, OFF by default (PROTOCOL §9); inert without it AND matches only status=='blink_seq'.

microtheory.name: blink_bridge
microtheory.description: the eye CONFABULATES across a temporal hole; grounding constrains the guess. A blink's belief is a best-guess continuation -- pinned to the pre-blink transition generator (G^t(f0), high confidence, invisible) under consistent motion, or the unconstrained freeze default (low confidence, the seed of hallucination) without one. Motion-continuing (belief at G^k(last), not frozen) when grounded; change-blind (a change during the blink is missed until divergence, then corrected -- the perceptible jump). PERCEPTION is liberal (fill by default); DISCOVERY (time_axis minting) stays conservative. The same grounded-field operation as the blind spot, with the surround in TIME and the grounding the transition generator.

rules.name: blink_bridge_fill
rules.comment: CONFABULATE BY DEFAULT. Flag ON (agent.blink_bridge_enabled==1). On a blink-sequence Observation (status=='blink_seq'), ALWAYS fill the temporal hole with a best-guess continuation -- perception does not go silent when ungrounded, it guesses (predictive coding: the prediction stands where there is no data). Grounding only CONSTRAINS the guess: a consistent motion (BlinkBridge.constrained==1) pins bridged to G^t(f0) at a confidence that FALLS OUT of support (confirm_run/(confirm_run+gap), RELATIVE, no constant); an ungrounded prefix (accelerating / shuffled) still fills, with the freeze default at confidence 0 -- UNCONSTRAINED, the seed of hallucination, NOT held-open and NOT silence. Writes the guess, the persistence baseline (frozen), the resume-divergence tick (diverged_at: -1 == invisible; >=0 == a change bridged over during the blink and revised on data return -> change blindness) and the correction magnitude (the perceptible 'jump'). status flips to 'blink_bridged'.
